messages:
kai (eng-runtime): FYI: canaries show a p95 tail spike after yesterday's kernel-selector + micro-batching change. p50 stable, p95 up ~3x on short requests.

zoe (perf): grabbed a quick pprof and strace. Top lines: tokenize_worker and writev syscalls dominate. Small grpc frames are much more frequent.

mira (eng-ml): did we change what we include in the variant hash? We added optional quant fields last week. That can make validate_variant() return rebuild more often.

zoe (perf): snippet from pprof top:
```
31%  tokenize_worker
18%  writev/syscall
11%  kernel_selector::validate_variant
9%   kv_cache::lookup
```

kai (eng-runtime): repro (wrk):
wrk -t8 -c180 -d30s --script=short_stream.lua http://canary:8080/v1/stream

zoe (perf): hypothesis: validate_variant -> allocator tear-down causes tokenizer pool churn; smaller batches mean more KV lookups and fewer amortized ops; plus skipped MSG_MORE on a fast-path -> syscall thrash.

mira (eng-ml): mitigation options: revert kernel-selector on canaries (fast), restrict hash to stable fields (medium), preserve tokenizer pool on no-op validate (medium), always set MSG_MORE for intermediate chunks (fast).

ops-bot: Initiating rollback of feature kernel-selector on canary group. Started.

zoe (perf): after rollback started canaries trending back to baseline p95 ~55ms (was ~160ms). I'll run a 10m wrk and post flamegraphs.

kai (eng-runtime): plan: rollback now, land stable-hash PR + tokenizer-pool guard, add MSG_MORE coalescing test, and add a perf-regression CI job that runs the short_stream scenario and fails if p95 increases >20%.

mira (eng-ml): adding unit test for hash stability and marking optional fields excluded.

zoe (perf): will add perf gate and a dashboard for validate.rebuild_count.

kai (eng-runtime): thanks. Holding rollout until fixes and perf gates are green.
